members.name: Steve Dawson
members.label: Leadership
members.bio: Steve Dawson has over 25 years of commercial real estate experience and 9 years in Specialist Disability Accommodation. He is a trusted board advisor to organisations such as Multiple Sclerosis Queensland, has sold SDA properties for multiple organisations, and has built a reputation for achieving results with discretion.
